privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overview: At SONA, we take your privacy seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring full transparency in how it is collected, used, and shared. This privacy policy outlines our practices in protecting your data in accordance with the best international standards and applicable laws.
privacy.s1c1: We collect information you provide directly when registering, including your full name, email address, phone number, and password.
privacy.s1c2: We collect information about your financial transactions on the Platform, such as deposits, withdrawals, and investments, as well as your activity log and account movements.
privacy.s1c3: We automatically collect technical data when you use the Platform, such as IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, and access history, to improve user experience and Platform security.
privacy.s2c1: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve Platform services, including processing financial transactions and providing technical support.
privacy.s2c2: We use your data to verify your identity and comply with regulatory requirements, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) laws.
privacy.s2c3: We use contact information to send important notifications about your account and Platform updates. We will not send you marketing messages without your explicit consent.
privacy.s2c4: We use technical data to analyze usage patterns, improve Platform security, and prevent fraud and unauthorized activities.
privacy.s3c1: We use AES-256 encryption to protect sensitive stored data, and TLS 1.3 encryption to protect data in transit between your device and our servers.
privacy.s3c2: We employ two-factor authentication (2FA) as an additional security layer for your account, and strongly recommend enabling it to protect your account from unauthorized access.
privacy.s3c3: Access to your personal data is limited to authorized employees who need this information to perform their job duties.
privacy.s3c4: We conduct periodic security audits and test our systems against potential attacks to ensure the highest levels of protection.
privacy.s4c1: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your information.
privacy.s4c2: We may share your data with external service providers necessary for operating the Platform, such as payment processors and cloud service providers, under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s4c3: We may disclose your information if required by law or upon request from an official regulatory authority, or to protect our rights or the safety of users.
privacy.s5c1: We use cookies to improve your experience on the Platform, such as keeping you logged in and remembering your language preferences.
privacy.s5c2: You can control cookie settings through your browser settings. Please note that disabling some cookies may affect Platform functionality.
privacy.s5c3: We use analytical cookies to understand how the Platform is used and to improve it. These cookies do not contain personal identification information.
privacy.s6c1: You have the right to access your personal data stored with us and request a copy at any time.
privacy.s6c2: You have the right to request correction of any inaccurate or incomplete data stored with us.
privacy.s6c3: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal requirements that oblige us to retain certain data for specified periods.
privacy.s6c4: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data for direct marketing purposes at any time.
privacy.s7c1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. You will be notified of any material changes via email or through a prominent notice on the Platform.
privacy.s7c2: We advise you to review this page periodically for any updates. Your continued use of the Platform after changes are published constitutes your agreement to the updated policy.
privacy.s7c3: If you have questions or concerns about the privacy policy, you can contact us via email: helpsona.support@gmail.com
privacy.dataControllerDesc: SONA is an electronic investment platform that cares about protecting your personal data according to the highest security standards.
